title: TD Task Descriptor Schema
description: Schema for validating Anigma task descriptors in Docs/td/. Each task must have a corresponding task.yaml file that conforms to this schema.

id.description: Unique task identifier. Must match the directory name or be a short UUID-like identifier.

status.description: Current status. Must match the directory location under Docs/td/.

lane.description: Functional grouping lane for this task.

description.description: Detailed description of the task's purpose and scope.

parent_epic.description: ID of the epic this task belongs to.

worktree.description: Default worktree path for this task. Should be a directory path relative to repo root.

recommended_worktree.description: Alias for worktree, preferred field name.

source_docs.description: List of paths to source documentation that define this task.

related_docs.description: List of paths to related documentation (roadmaps, ADRs, architecture docs).

related_diagrams.description: List of paths to related diagrams/flowcharts.

proofs.description: List of paths to proof artifacts under Docs/proofs/ for this task.

proof_required.description: List of required proof artifacts that must exist before this task is complete.

expected_proof.description: List of expected proof artifacts that will be generated by this task.

no_goals.description: Single string describing what this task is NOT about.

test_plan.description: Test plan or verification steps for this task.

test_commands.description: List of test commands to run to verify this task.

dependencies.description: List of task/epic IDs that must be completed before this task can start.

blocks.description: List of task/epic IDs that this task blocks.

blocked_by.description: List of task/epic IDs that are blocking this task.

assigned_to.description: Assigned agent or human for this task.

claimant.description: Who claimed this task for execution.

created.description: Date when this task was initially created.

updated.description: Date when this task was last updated.

started.description: Date when work started on this task.

completed.description: Date when this task was completed.

verification_profiles.description: List of verification profile IDs from verification-profiles.yaml that apply to this task.

verification_overrides.description: Override verification profile settings for this specific task.

gc_policy.description: Garbage collection policy for task context. Default is compact_on_complete for tasks.

context_load_policy.description: Context loading policy. Default is lazy for tasks.

research_stage.description: Current research stage for this task. See TD_RESEARCH_AND_TIMELINE_DOCTRINE.md for stage semantics.

research_files.description: List of files inspected as part of task-level research.

inspected_symbols.description: List of symbols inspected as part of task research. Only populated when actually inspected.

change_map.description: Path to the task-level change-map.yaml file, if it exists.

timeline.description: Path to the task-level timeline.yaml file, if it exists.

decisions.description: List of decision IDs from the task's decision log or referencing epic decisions.

path.description: Path to the affected documentation file.

canonical_doc_effects.description: Effects this task has or will have on canonical documentation.

rule.description: The doctrine rule being aligned with.

reference.description: Path to the doctrine document containing this rule.

waiver_requested.description: Whether a waiver has been requested.

waiver_approved.description: Who approved the waiver, if granted.

doctrine_alignment.description: Task-level doctrine alignment for planned changes.

affected_files.description: Files expected to be affected by this task. Only populated when actually identified.
